text.en:
Appropriation of Funds. The following sums, or so much thereof as may be necessary, are hereby appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury of the Philippines no otherwise appropriated, for the operation of the Government of the Republic of the Philippines from January one to December thirty-one, two thousand and fourteen, except where otherwise specifically provided herein:
Appropriations by Agency and Fund and by Program, Project and Activity I.
